title: Vinod's hidden background as friend of Gandhi and Bombay professor

tellings.quote: Vinod was his name. He He was friends with Gandhi, right?

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a man known as Dr. Vinod, who came to the United States in the early 1950s and is tied to a story of contact with an alien council, had a hidden past. According to Malatzi, Vinod had been a professor in Bombay, India, and a friend of Gandhi, the leader of India's independence movement. If true, it would mean the man at the heart of the contact story had serious standing.
